content:
A **Radtoad Leg** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

The raw leg of a Radtoad that has been harvested off its corpse. Can be consumed raw to satisfy a small amount of hunger with a very high dose of Radiation and a high disease chance, or can be cooked for additional benefits.

Has a 20% chance to drop from killed radtoads. Use of the Butcher's Bounty perk gives a chance for an additional piece to drop.

The value of Radtoad Leg is unusually high (60 caps) compared to the value after cooking of Fried Radtoad Legs (12 caps).
